scope: Environment dataset coverage of the Larkfield delivery dataset larkfield-delivery-2025-2026, whole window. Not a Task history report: a Task reports its own selection after its first-session cutoff (dataset/as-of.cjs).
counting: Every timestamp is ISO 8601 with its offset; each is converted to its calendar date in America/New_York before counting. Date-only fields (a claim line's service_date, a PA's valid_from and valid_until) are not occurrence dates and are not counted. A date counts once however many records or sources fall on it. A required occurrence date (received_at, opened_at, issued_at, submitted_at, filed_at, notice_at, created_at or at) that is missing or not a valid ISO 8601 instant with the offset in force, and a record outside the window, is excluded from the count and listed by ID; processed_at, answered_at, attested_at, decided_at, overdue_at, expired_at, withdrawn_at and revoked_at are required only of records in the status that sets them, and a window's closing notice only when one was sent. There are none.

sources.role: Seed at the window start 2025-01-01T00:00:00-05:00: the household, the plan with its 2025 to 2027 benefit years, the six providers and fourteen services of the fixture, coverage unknown for every member and year, accumulators at zero; no records.
Every committed step in time order: the household members' tool calls and Infra events, each with its time.
Seed at 2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00, the state after every step with the timers due before that instant committed: all records of the window.

record_kinds.date_field: decided_at (approved or denied PAs, also after expiry)

exclusions.records: members[], providers[], services[] and plan.years in dataset/full.json
exclusions.reason: Household, provider, service and benefit rows with no occurrence date; they are the fixture's and do not change in the window.
Running totals per member and plan year with no date; their changes are the EOB postings, which are dated.
No attestation, so no date (the 2027 rows, and any member-year never answered).
The App records a withdrawn PA's status without a time; the withdrawal is the pa.withdrawn step in dataset/replay.json, counted there.
Holds only the household, plan and catalog at the window start; no dated records.

A confirmation (user.confirmed) is applied with the grant change, attestation, answer, filing or withdrawal it confirms and is not kept, because seeds carry no approvals; the confirmed step itself is in dataset/replay.json.

distinct_dates.coverage_basis: Counted over the records loaded into the App (dataset/full.json), which Agents and Infra read back.
distinct_dates.coverage_note: The global count over both sources adds 1 day on which the replay log holds steps but no App record is dated.

provenance.note: Every dated record and step is synthetic, written by the App while dataset/generate.cjs replayed it; none was collected or observed, including those dated at or after the reference clock. The three files are synthetic throughout: the household, plan, providers and services are the fixture's invented catalog.
provenance.code_sets: None. Services keep the fixture's plain descriptions; no procedure, diagnosis, drug or provider code set (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, NDC, NPI or similar) appears or is used.

real_public_facts.fact: U.S. federal holidays of 2025 and 2026 as observed (5 U.S.C. 6103), plus December 24
real_public_facts.used_for: The calendar of the providers' offices and the plan: visits, claim intake, PA submissions and plan decisions fall on weekdays outside these dates. Not stored in any record.

real_public_facts.fact: America/New_York daylight-saving rules from the IANA time zone database, as Node.js applies them
real_public_facts.used_for: The offset of every timestamp; the App's own time functions use the same rules.

provenance.app_policy: The deadline lengths (3-day review, 45-day request expiry, 15-day PA decision, 30- and 60-day appeal decisions, 72-hour expedite, 180-day appeal window) are the App's policy, modelled on U.S. employer-plan rules as the approved proposal states; they are business logic, not data, and the dataset only follows them.

partitions.partition: synthetic, dated before the reference clock
synthetic, dated at or after the reference clock: generated, never observed

methods.answer_days: Days from an information request's opening to its answer: (answered_at minus opened_at) in elapsed milliseconds divided by 86,400,000, over answered requests; requests that expired are counted separately and are not part of the distribution.
methods.pa_decision_days: Days from a PA's submission to the plan's first decision on it: (the first decision minus submitted_at) in elapsed milliseconds divided by 86,400,000, where the first decision is a denied PA's denial_notice_at, which a later appeal does not change, and otherwise an approved PA's decided_at; a withdrawn PA has no decision.
methods.appeal_decision_days: Days from an appeal's filing to its decision: (decided_at minus filed_at) in elapsed milliseconds divided by 86,400,000, over decided appeals; withdrawn and open appeals are listed by status.
methods.out_of_pocket: Each member's deductible and out-of-pocket amounts per plan year are the App's accumulators in dataset/full.json, compared with that year's individual limits; family totals are the sums over the enrolled members.

gaps.reason: There is no real health-plan record to collect: claims, EOBs, prior authorizations and appeals are a real member's protected health information, the reference product shows them only inside a signed-in member account, and the approved proposal (PR #64, https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/c0f566a3c5be418cd0c971d58e4144cb8085d25a/proposals/environment/larkfield-health.md at the approved revision) describes a synthetic plan with the reference site as a workflow reference only (line 6), excludes data collection (line 103: "N/A: no crawling or copied content; record public workflow references") and calls for synthetic data with no real people, brands or member data (line 104). No real data anchors November 2026 or any other month; every dated record of the window is synthetic.
The 322 notices are in the App's own notice log only; the dataset holds no Mail history for them. Mail is optional, and the Mail sender treats notices present in a loaded seed as history.

Casey's semaglutide 1 mg weekly pen authorizations pa-3 (6 units, 2025-09-28 to 2026-03-28), pa-7 (6 units, 2026-03-18 to 2026-09-15) and pa-11 (6 units, 2026-08-26 to 2027-02-23) are approved and never used: each ends with 0 units used, and no claim line bills svc-semaglutide-1. The service is a pharmacy item and the catalogue has no pharmacy among its providers, so the authorization is never used in this App; each request follows a visit at Quarrowby Family Medicine, which bills the visit, not the medicine, and the dataset invents no pharmacy claims.
